selection_reason: Fastest mean convergence among the three corrected-protocol finalists, all eight development seeds solved, and improved late and held-out returns relative to the seven-qubit finalist. The seven-qubit model's previous failed validation is retained and informed this choice; this is the second locked comparison, not the first.
circuit: 21 qubits partitioned into seven disjoint triples; H D(s) H with per-qubit affine RZ encoding, all three RZZ pairs and one RZZZ in each triple, and global binary majority over all 21 bits.
initialization: Independent affine feature weights Uniform[0,2pi); trainable local biases initialized to pi/2; independent trainable RZZ/RZZZ angles Normal(0,0.5^2).
training: 500 episodes, maximum 200 steps per episode; identical REINFORCE/Adam settings for both models. Freezing requires a full 100-episode trailing window with mean return at least 195, checked at five-episode optimizer batch boundaries.
evaluation: 100 fresh frozen-policy episodes per training seed, paired reset/action seeds across models.
success_rule: Both normalized training-return AUC and restricted episode-to-solve must improve, with positive paired-bootstrap 95% confidence intervals and exact paired sign-randomization p-values corrected by Holm for two endpoints and then by factor two for two locked comparisons below 0.05.
scope: Comparison against the existing 65-parameter MLP, not a parameter-matched baseline or quantum computational advantage. Disjoint constant-size entangled blocks permit efficient exact classical evaluation of this IQP policy.
freeze_correction: Explicitly approved by the user for both models; old results remain separate.
